sentences.text:
2.Heard the learned Counsel appearing for the appellant, the learned Counsel appearing for the respondents 1 and 5 and perused the materials available on record.
3. The learned Counsel appearing for the appellant has submitted that the driver of Ambulance did not have valid license to drive the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis vehicle, hence the appellant is not liable to pay compensation to the claimants.
The driver was entitled to drive only non-commercial light motor vehicle.
4. This Court is of the considered opinion that the vehicle involved in the accident was an ambulance which is classified under LMV vehicle.
Therefore, nothing survives for adjudication in this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal.
5. Hence, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
